rhea: PR opened to add a short guide: audit export examples + retention best-practices. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4280
omar: paste curl/python so SDK team can confirm parity?
rhea: curl:
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=acme-inc&retain=30d&redact=true" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"format":"ndjson","since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}'

python example:
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acme-inc', retain='30d', redact=True, format='ndjson', since='2026-03-01T00:00:00Z')
if resp.status_code == 200:
    print(resp.download_url)
else:
    print('export failed', resp.status_code)

viv: Security/legal: reword for SOC2 neutrality. Use: "Example uses a 30-day retention window; configure retention according to your policy." Add note: exported files are available briefly (24h) and all access is logged. Also add redaction policy options: pii-only / full / none and a short one-liner for trade-offs.
